in_marathi.name: Chandramani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandramani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandramani is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Chandra' (moon) and 'mAni' (adorned, decorated). It refers to someone who is adorned with the radiance of the moon. In Hindu mythology, Chandramani is also the name of a celestial elephant that carries Lord Indra, the god of rain and thunder.
